title: Chapter 82
content:
Clamping a cigarette between his teeth, Jakyeong methodically field-stripped his sidearm, running a solvent-soaked rag along the slide. The second contract was scheduled for tomorrow night—a high-angle tactical breach requiring him to rappel down from the rooftop—demanding that every weapon and harness be in flawless, operational order.

Yet every few seconds, the mortifying events of the morning resurfaced, wrenching heavy, irritated sighs from his chest.

Sitting across the patio, Wang Han glanced up from his maintenance kit. "Let it go, Wei. President Kang let it slide anyway."

He didn't let it slide. Jakyeong knew that maniac would weaponize the "ancient fossil" incident to mock him for the next hundred years. In many ways, the man shared the exact same intolerable, teasing streak as Wang Ryun.

Right on cue, Ryun sauntered onto the patio, beaming ear to ear after an extensive video call with his girlfriend.

Jakyeong glared daggers as he slotted brass cartridges into a fresh magazine: Click, click.

"Why the death glare, little brother?" Ryun asked with a sly grin.

Jakyeong ground his molars together. "You're the one who spilled your guts to him, aren't you?"

"What choice did I have? If you’d seen President Kang’s face last night, you would've confessed your life's sins on the spot."

Han nodded in solemn agreement. The two had been having a late drink in the adjacent suite when a violent racket erupted from Jakyeong’s quarters. Rushing in, they found the living room trashed, the CEO sporting a bleeding gash across his nose, his collar ripped open, and his eyes burning with the lethal fury of a wounded predator ready to tear someone limb from limb.

Ryun had promptly blurted out everything that happened at the hotel lobby—even tossing in the speculation that Jakyeong had thrown a jealous fit.

The moment the context registered, the murderous wrath vanished from Il-hyun's face, instantly replaced by a smug, radiant smile. For a man who seemed completely unreadable to the rest of the world, his reactions regarding Jakyeong were laughably transparent.

"He's genuinely smitten with you," Han remarked casually.

Ryun chuckled. "Did you see him at breakfast? After getting choked half to death, the man was practically dripping honey from his eyes."

"I can't speak on his sanity," Han added, "but he certainly doesn't view your relationship as a passing fling."

"I knew it from the start," Ryun boasted. "If he actually wanted us dead, he would've put a bullet in my skull the moment he caught me."

"Fair point."

"And Wei... you really need to work on your filter. You have a terrible habit of reaching for the cruellest insult on the shelf."

Jakyeong arched a brow. "What's that supposed to mean?"

"Calling a thirty-year-old an ancient fossil was uncalled for. Even my feelings would've been hurt."

Han’s brow pinched as an old grievance surfaced. "He's right. Back in Macau, he lost his temper and screamed at me, calling me a bald old bastard."

Ryun offered a look of deep, empathetic solidarity, subconsciously touching his own receding hairline. "Cruel. Truly heartless. As if his own hairline is guaranteed to stay lush forever."

Han chuckled. "Exactly. At least you understand my pain."

"Imagine if President Kang turned around and called you a sneaky little fox cub," Ryun teased. "How would you like that?"

Jakyeong gnashed his teeth. He had been compared to a fox since childhood, and he despised the label with a passion.

"Look at that," Ryun laughed. "His eyes are slitting into daggers already."

"Shut up and let me work," Jakyeong snapped, refocusing on the receiver.

Whose side are these two even on?

With every passing day, Ryun seemed increasingly enamored with Kang Il-hyun. Ever since the man had descended from a military chopper raining gunfire and grenades onto their island hideout, Ryun had developed an embarrassing admiration for the CEO's ruthless, masculine swagger.

Packing the cleaned firearms into the lockbox, the three dispersed to their respective rooms to rest.

Jakyeong collapsed across his bed, attempting to center his mind for tomorrow's breach. He pulled up ambient meditation tracks on his phone, sitting cross-legged on the rug to breathe through the tension, trying to purge the toxic irritation from his system.

It was entirely useless.

Every time he closed his eyes, Il-hyun’s smug, triumphant grin from the dining table flashed in his mind.

To hell with meditation.

Deciding that sweating it out under the sun was a better way to burn off the frustration, he stripped off his clothes, pulled on a pair of fitted swim trunks, grabbed his sunglasses and earphones, and headed down to the pool deck.
Sitting in the back of his executive sedan, Il-hyun tipped his head against the headrest, letting out a frustrated groan.

Construction on the luxury integrated resort in Jeju had hit a massive snag. Friction with local environmental coalitions had escalated into an all-out physical brawl on-site this morning, prompting police intervention and an immediate injunction on the build.

The emergency required his immediate presence on the island, forcing an uncharacteristically early departure from the office.

He had spent the entire morning looking forward to tormenting his little stray tonight; having his plans derailed by corporate red tape was thoroughly irritating.

As the sedan turned down the private drive of the estate, Il-hyun’s eyes drifted toward the pool.

Lying prone on a teak sun lounger was Lee Ja-kyeong.

Stripped down to dark swim trunks, the boy was basking under the afternoon sun, an arm tucked beneath his head, dark sunglasses shielding his eyes with earbuds firmly in place.

Il-hyun gave Tae-soo a flick of his fingers, signaling him to go ahead inside, before stepping toward the pool deck.

At point-blank range, the mottled purple bruises and love bites across the boy's back and shoulders were starkly visible. The firm, high curve of his buttocks drew the eye instantly, the branded tattoo on his lower hip partially concealed by the low waistband.

A sudden urge to pull the fabric down and taste the heated skin flared in Il-hyun's chest.

Sinking onto the edge of the adjacent lounger, Il-hyun trailed his fingers from the boy's shoulder down the groove of his spine.

Jakyeong shifted, turning his head as he pushed the sunglasses up his brow, blinking through drowsy, sleep-hazed lashes.

"Trying to turn yourself into barbecue?"

Jakyeong sat up, rubbing his face with both hands. Glancing at his watch, his brow knit in confusion. It wasn't even three in the afternoon—what was Kang Il-hyun doing home?

Before he could ask, Il-hyun unfurled a plush bath sheet, wrapping it firmly around Jakyeong’s shoulders.

"I prefer keeping this magnificent body reserved strictly for my eyes."

As Il-hyun fastened the towel, his index finger dropped playfully, flicking the tender, swollen peak of Jakyeong’s nipple. Jakyeong swatted the hand away with an irritated scowl.

Il-hyun licked his bottom lip, a slow, predatory smirk spreading across his face.

"I believe we have some unfinished business from breakfast."

Jakyeong tensed, moving to bolt from the lounger, but Il-hyun caught him by the wrist, forcing him back down onto the cushions.

Shedding his tailored suit jacket, Il-hyun rolled his dress sleeves up his forearms. A maid arrived with a silver tray bearing freshly blended watermelon juice and iced espresso. Once the staff cleared the patio, Il-hyun slid the chilled juice toward Jakyeong.

"Not that I owe you an explanation... but that woman at the hotel is purely a business colleague."

Jakyeong took a long pull from the glass straw, keeping his eyes forward. Il-hyun watched the movement of his lips with quiet focus.

"I didn't ask," Jakyeong muttered.

"Your brothers said you threw a fit."

"They're full of shit."

"So it didn't bother you in the slightest?"

Jakyeong’s throat went dry. Admitting the truth bruised his pride, but doubling down on a lie felt like walking into another of Il-hyun's calculated traps.

While he hesitated, Il-hyun took Jakyeong's hand, pressing the boy's palm against his own warm cheek with a fond, teasing smile.

"Stop tormenting an old fossil, darling. Playing hard to get only works if you don't overdo it."

Jakyeong snatched his hand back, flustered. The way the man chewed over the words old fossil made it abundantly clear the slight had left a deep, lingering mark.

Just as Jakyeong considered offering a reluctant apology, Park Tae-soo emerged from the villa carrying a leather garment bag and travel luggage.

Il-hyun met Jakyeong’s eyes, his smile turning soft.

"An emergency came up on Jeju. I have to fly down immediately... so we'll have to table our little chat until I return."

Jakyeong breathed an inward sigh of profound relief. Spared.

"Don't celebrate just yet," Il-hyun added smoothly. "I'll be back tomorrow afternoon."

Damn it. You could've stayed down there for a month.

"Now then... give me a proper send-off hug."

Jakyeong blinked. "Why should I?"

"You've never initiated physical affection on your own."

"..."

"Consider it an old fossil's dying wish."

Jakyeong gritted his teeth. He's going to milk this till the day he dies.

Checking the perimeter, Tae-soo was loading the trunk and the security sentries were stationed far out of sight. Reluctantly, Jakyeong leaned forward, extending his arms in an awkward embrace.

Wrapping his hands around Il-hyun's neck, the crisp, tailored scent of aftershave filled his senses. Il-hyun responded instantly, pulling Jakyeong tight against his chest until their bare torsos were flush.

An embrace stripped of raw lust felt strangely intimate—and deeply disorienting.

As Jakyeong pulled back, Il-hyun’s lips closed the distance.

Instead of dodging, Jakyeong lowered his lashes, letting the contact land. Their lips brushed, and Il-hyun slipped his tongue inside, taking a slow, thorough taste of his mouth before drawing away. Il-hyun wore a look of lingering reluctance; Jakyeong, catching himself feeling a brief pang of the same emptiness, bit his bottom lip in quiet frustration.

The sentiment didn't last ten seconds.

"Just holding you gets me rock-hard," Il-hyun purred, casually adjusting the distinct, rigid bulge tenting the front of his slacks.

Jakyeong recoiled in pure disgust. "Put that away before someone sees you!"

Il-hyun let out a low chuckle, catching the back of Jakyeong’s neck to pull him into another deep, bruising kiss. Panting against his lips, Il-hyun whispered:

"I have ten minutes before wheels up. Come behind the villa with me for a quickie."

"Are you out of your fucking mind?!"

Before Jakyeong could yank his arm free, Il-hyun hauled him to his feet, coaxing and dragging him along the flagstones.

"I won't even make you do anything. Don't worry."

"Let go of me, you lunatic!"

Jakyeong fought the grip, but Il-hyun steered him effortlessly into the secluded courtyard behind the residence. Pinned against the stone wall, Il-hyun captured his mouth with ravenous hunger.

Jakyeong shoved at the broad shoulders, pointing an urgent finger toward the high-definition security camera mounted along the eaves.

Unfazed, Il-hyun plucked a smooth landscaping stone from the flowerbed and pressed it into Jakyeong’s palm.

Without thinking, pure muscle memory took over—Jakyeong whipped his arm forward, hurling the stone in a blinding arc that shattered the camera's mounting bracket, knocking the lens straight toward the sky.

Il-hyun beamed. "Nice shot."

Why the hell did I just do that?

Before Jakyeong could process his own complicity, Kang Il-hyun sank to his knees on the manicured grass.

Jakyeong’s jaw dropped. In a single fluid motion, Il-hyun hooked the waistband of the swim trunks, dragging them down to expose the weeping, semi-hard shaft.

Panic flaring, Jakyeong grabbed fistfuls of Il-hyun's dark hair, trying to shove him back. "Are you a dog in heat?!"

"No," Il-hyun rasped against his skin. "I'm a certified mark."

"..."

"After being thoroughly humiliated yesterday... here I am on my knees, begging to suck your cock."

"..."

"After this much effort... fuck, darling, give in a little."

A breathless smirk curved Il-hyun's lips before he took the full length into his mouth.

Jakyeong’s head fell back against the warm stone wall, his teeth biting down hard on his lip. Above the perimeter wall, the dark crimson climbing roses were in full, lush bloom.

Wet, slick sounds echoed in the quiet garden. Looking down, Il-hyun’s cheeks hollowed deeply as he bobbed his head, taking the shaft all the way to his throat.

Infuriatingly, the sight of a powerful, ruthless CEO on his knees, enthusiastically choking on his erection, was intoxicating beyond measure.

Jakyeong’s fingers tightened in the dark locks, his hips instinctively thrusting forward into the heat.

Harder. Deeper.

An electric, scalding rush surged through his veins, his mind abandoning reason as he chased the friction.
